articles.summary: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (NYSE: MSGE ) (“MSG Entertainment” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026. The fiscal 2027 first quarter was marked by a diverse slate of live entertainment offerings across the Company’s portfolio of venues. This included a new record for the number of concerts in any quarter at the Madison Square Garden Arena (“The Garden”). Subsequent to the end of the quarter, the New York Knicks (“Knicks”) and New York Rangers (“Rangers”) began their 2026-27 regular seasons at The Garden. And later today, the Christmas Spectacular production begins its 2026 holiday season at Radio City Music Hall with 231 planned performances as compared to 215 in fiscal 2026. articles.title: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. Reports Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results

(NYSE: MSGE ) (“MSG Entertainment”) celebrated the final show of Harry Styles’ sold-out 30-night “Together, Together” residency at MSG tonight by raising a banner to The Garden’s rafters and unveiling a new “Defining Moments” exhibit at the arena. During tonight’s final show of the unprecedented 30-night run, and less than two weeks after their own banner was raised to The Garden’s rafters, New York Knicks Captain and 2026 Finals MVP Jalen Brunson presented the commemorative banner to Styles. Additionally, The Garden unveiled a new “Defining Moments” exhibit on the venue’s sixth-floor concourse, featuring memorabilia from Styles’ run, that is now on display for all fans attending events at MSG.
